camel_example: aliyun live DescribeLiveStreamSnapshotInfo --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName liveStream0000 --EndTime '2017-12-22T08:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --StartTime '2017-12-21T08:00:00Z' --AppName liveApp0000
description_en: Queries snapshot content within a specified time range
description_zh: 查询某一段时间内截图内容
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-stream-snapshot-info --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveStreamSnapshotInfo

parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain of the streamer.
When you specify DomainName, make sure that the domain name is a live streaming domain name and that the user who calls this operation has the permissions to operate on the specified domain name
parameters.help_zh:
主播流域名。
传入DomainName时，请保证传入域名为直播域名，同时调用本接口的用户拥有传入域名的操作权限
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the stream belongs
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the stream. Make sure that the specified stream name exists within the query time range
parameters.help_zh: 播流名称，请确保传入的流名在查询时间段内是存在的
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en: The end time. The interval between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 1 day. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。EndTime和StartTime之间的间隔不能超过1天。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return in a single call. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 一次调用获取的数量。取值范围：1~100， 默认值：10
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

asc (default): ascending order.
desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序。取值：

asc（默认值）：升序。
desc：降序
parameters.name: order

NextStartTime.description_en: The next start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC). If the content within this time range exceeds the value of Limit, this parameter is returned as the creation time of the next file. You can use this time as the StartTime value and call this operation again to retrieve the next set of content. If this parameter is not returned, the content does not exceed the Limit value
NextStartTime.description_zh: 下一个起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 当此时间范围内的内容超出了Limit的取值范围，则返回此参数，为下一个文件的创建时间。可以将此时间当做StartTime，重新调用此接口获取下一段内容，不传则表示未超出Limit取值范围
